name: ecology-hub
description: Ecology — the framework-agnostic design system hub (tokens + specs + Astro specimens).

scripts.dev: npm run build:tokens && npm run dev --workspace=@esa/site
scripts.build: npm run build:tokens && npm run build --workspace=@esa/site
scripts.storybook: npm run build:tokens && npm run stories:generate && node scripts/storybook-dev.mjs
scripts.build:storybook: npm run build:tokens && npm run stories:generate && npm run build --workspace=@esa/storybook-astro && npm run build --workspace=@esa/storybook
scripts.deploy: npm run build:tokens && npm run deploy --workspace=@esa/site
